subject: Post-demo: unit-rate schedule & suggested commit tiers (Insight AI)
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Jensen <alex@insightai.com>, Priya Shah <priya@insightai.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 2 May 2027 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: unit-rate schedule & suggested commit tiers (Insight AI)

Alex / Priya — thanks again for a crisp product + technical deep-dive today. Quick recap and next steps on pricing/volume so we can scope a tailored Dedicated proposal: 

What we heard (please correct if off):
- Primary workload: conversational assistant + context-aware retrieval, avg seq length ~1.4k tokens / prompt.
- Expected initial monthly volume (Q3): 500M tokens; target steady-state by Q4: 1.2B tokens / month.
- Budget range: $6k–$14k / month (flexible if committed capacity reduces unit costs).
- Key ask: target $/1M token rate (you mentioned $8–$10 / 1M as a desirable sweet spot).

Preliminary positioning vs hosts (high level):
- Open-hosts (self-hosted or spot capacity) tend to sit in the lower-cost band but with variable latency and ops overhead.
- Anthropic/OpenAI (managed model providers) are typically higher unit-cost but simpler ops and stronger out-of-the-box quality for larger models.
- Redwood Dedicated can hit competitive unit economics when paired with reserved capacity + batching + KV/prefix caching.

Initial recommendation (what I'll ask our pricing/infra leads to model):
- A 12-month reserved commitment with a tiered per-1M structure (higher volume -> lower $/1M).
- Example tiers (workshop numbers only): <100M -> ~$12/1M, 100–500M -> ~$8/1M, >500M -> ~$6/1M. Those assume medium aggressiveness on quantization and sustained KV cache hit rates; we can tighten with a firm commit.

Attachments: I attached the usage forecast you shared (renamed) and our internal tier deck for reference.

Next steps:
1) Can you confirm the 500M–1.2B target band and the budget comfort range? (one-line reply is fine)
2) Aditya — can you validate the assumptions above (cache hit, quantization, expected latency SLOs) and produce a first-pass cost model?
3) If ranges look good, Marissa and I will prepare a 12-month reserved quote (with an optional 3-month pilot).

Thanks — talk soon,
Evelyn Hart
Senior Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
T 415-555-0112

Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 09:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: unit-rate schedule & suggested commit tiers (Insight AI)

Thanks, Evelyn — that summary is spot on. A couple quick clarifications: 

- Volume: we were conservative on the call. Internal forecast (best case) is 1.0–1.5B by end of Q4; base case 600–900M.
- Budget: our procurement team has ~12k/mo in the near term but could stretch to ~30k/mo with an annual commitment and guaranteed latency SLOs.
- Target unit: $8/1M was our internal target; $6/1M would be ideal if achievable with a 12–24 month commit.

We're also sensitive to the distinction between average token cost and tail-case (long prompts + multimodal attachments). Can you confirm if the tier numbers you listed include tail/headroom?

If you can send a basic tiered SKU (pilot -> committed) and markups for additional latency or enterprise features (private VPC, KMS), we'll share with procurement this week.

- Alex
VP Product, Insight AI
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>

Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 11:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: unit-rate schedule & suggested commit tiers (Insight AI)

Looping in technical/pricing detail. Notes on assumptions and a quick model: 

Assumptions we used to generate the example tiers: 
- Model variant: quantized open LLM (8-bit) optimized for Redwood runtime; throughput-efficient kernel.
- Avg sequence tokens per request: 1.4k (as called out).
- KV/prefix cache hit: 28% (gains depend heavily on prompt reuse; if you can surface canonical prompts we can push cache to 45%+).
- Avg tokens billed per eval after caching: ~1,000 tokens.
- Infrastructure: Dedicated A100 / H100 equivalent pools with autoscale headroom; reserved pricing amortized across committed throughput.

Cost model (back-of-envelope) — monthly effective cost per 1M tokens: 
- Raw infra + infra ops: $4–$6 / 1M (depends on commit and quantization).
- Platform + support + HA: add $1.5–$2.5 / 1M.
- Margin target for Redwood & variable costs -> results in list price bands shown below.

Suggested public-facing tier (example):
- Pilot (no commit, managed Hosted): $18 / 1M
- 3–6 month pilot with small commit (~50M/mo): $12 / 1M
- 12-month committed tiers: 
  - 0–100M: $11 / 1M
  - 100–500M: $8 / 1M
  - >500M: $6 / 1M

Optional add-ons / markups: private VPC + KMS: +$1.75 / 1M (or fixed $2k/mo), stricter latency SLO & dedicated threads for tails: +$0.75–$2.00 / 1M depending on headroom.

If Alex/Priya are targeting $6 / 1M flat, that is achievable but will require: 
- Firm 12–24 month commit toward >=500M/month OR
- Upfront payment/annual prepay to de-risk capacity + acceptance of our latency SLO requirements.

I attached an internal slide (pricing_tiers_v2.pdf) with the math and sensitivity to cache hit. Happy to walk through numbers on a short call.

— Aditya
Head of Inference Economics | Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Post-demo: unit-rate schedule & suggested commit tiers (Insight AI)

Alex / Priya — thanks for the fast feedback and for the budget clarity. Short follow-up and next steps so procurement has what they need this week: 

1) Proposal (what we'll send today): a) 3-month pilot SKU (managed hosted) at $12 / 1M with a path to convert to Dedicated reserved; b) 12-month reserved quote (tiered) with a baseline example: 0–100M $11/1M, 100–500M $8/1M, >500M $6/1M. Pilot credit toward committed contract if you convert within 90 days.
2) Add-ons: VPC + KMS option (fixed $2k/mo or +$1.75/1M), enterprise SLAs for tail latency (negotiable; will include cost estimate).
3) To hit $6/1M flat: we need a confirmed >=500M/mo commit for 12–24 months OR an annual prepay. If procurement wants a blended guarantee with lower minimum, we can model a hybrid (blended effective $7–8/1M).

Please confirm by EOD if procurement wants the 12-month reserved quote sent to legal/procurement. Otherwise we will ship pilot + 12-month illustrative quote for internal review.

Proposed next meeting: 30-min follow-up on Thursday to run through the reserved-deploy architecture and guardrails (Marissa to cover contract terms). Available slots: Thu 5/6 9–10am PT or 4–4:30pm PT.

Thanks — Evelyn
Senior Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
